q2_gaps: A capitalized PLURAL kind-word label with no name-hood signal ("the Keepers"): the "capitalized common noun used as the referent's only label = common noun by default" rule is explicitly declared singular-collective only, and the plural carve-out fires only when the label is "referring as a name" ("the Wrens") with no test given for that condition — so a definite capitalized plural role-word has no stated default between the GroupOf group route taken here and a Name-only individual.
notes: Given the group reading, everything else follows: definite plural -> GroupOf witness, distributive predicate -> per-member rule over (PartOf $x <group>), "rarely" -> strength 0.1 plus a QuantifierPhrase companion naming the group's kind, burn -> Patient, bare mass object as a bare kind filler, and no group event for a habitual. (Inheritance wintergloss gloss) is the default solid-spelling decomposition but the IS-A test looks doubtful for what reads as a coined plant name, where the "hot dog is not a dog" clause would suppress the genus.
